events.summary: Long Beach Mayor Rex Richardson sought federal answers after Ricardo Gonzalez was detained by ICE agents in North Long Beach on Oct. 17 and taken for medical care after a confrontation; ABC7 reported that Rep. Robert Garcia called for an investigation, while Long Beach reporting described disputed witness and ICE accounts, including an ICE spokesperson's minimum-force and vehicle-damage claims.
events.title: Long Beach mayor seeks federal answers after disputed Oct. 17 ICE encounter
